title: The leak scan passes a single-line EC key body that a period, underscore or hyphen follows, which the scan before BG-7mxo4k6p flagged
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits flags a single-line EC key body of 20 or more base64 characters that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows, and still does not flag the EC armor label quoted before a repository path such as the sql2022-views.md page or the Win32.md page

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon
d = "-" * 5
arm = d + "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY" + d
hit = lambda t: any(k == "secret" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t))
bodies = {"plain": "MHcCAQEEIGtq3xaH5wq7CUAKmJdZ0PY4RnXqPIYV1S2qt1NWOEHJoAoGCCqGSM49AwEHoUQDQgAE", "slashy": "MHcCAQEEIGtq3xaH5wq7CU/AKmJdZ0PY4RnXq+IYV1S2qt1NWOEHJoAoGCCqGSM49AwEHoUQ/QgAE", "short": "MHcCAQEEIGtq3xaH5wq7CUAK"}
miss = [(n, s) for n, b in bodies.items() for s in (".", "_x", "-x", ".pem") if not hit(arm + " " + b + s)]
paths = ["the kb/public/mecm/sql2022-views.md page", "the kb/public/Intune/Apps/Win32.md page"]
false = [p for p in paths if hit(arm + " " + p)]
print("key body not flagged:", miss, "path flagged:", false)
sys.exit(1 if miss or false else 0)

gates.question: Which rule separates a repository path from an EC key body that a period, underscore or hyphen follows?
options: Start lookahead on short slash-separated segments
No slash allowed in the run
gates.recommendation: Start lookahead on short slash-separated segments
gates.answer: Start lookahead on short slash-separated segments

notes: Planned in SP-jopt2c3z (2026-10-24 day run). Premise run on base: the repro exits 1 (every suffix of the plain, slash-containing and 24-character bodies passes the scan). Feasibility: in a scratch copy of _tools, replacing the (?![_.]|-(?!----)) lookahead of _KEY by a start lookahead (?!(?:[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}/)+[A-Za-z0-9]{1,16}[._-]) (a run that is short slash-separated segments before a dot, underscore or hyphen is a repository path) makes the repro exit 0; roughly 70 percent of real 78-character bodies hold a slash, so a no-slash rule would leave most real bodies unflagged. The worker may choose another rule that keeps the repro green. Tests: extend the planted case in an existing test_leaks.py function (the leak scan is a critical component); add no new test id. Severity raised S3 to S2 on the operator's brief (a leak-scan regression). Gate g1 (design, provisional, answered by the worker on its recommendation) confirmed by the sprint runner after the reviewer's report: recommendation 'Start lookahead on short slash-separated segments' kept (pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-24 day run). Reason: the alternative 'No slash allowed in the run' leaves about 70 percent of real 78-character bodies unflagged; the reviewer found only narrow gaps (short bodies of 20 to 40 characters, a path segment over 16 characters), parked as BG-w4af2tix and BG-v5tq4jkz.
